subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay media from `requireMention` group messages that did not address the bot, and what bounded retention/visibility policy should govern it?
rationale: The code path and user impact are clear, but storing unmentioned room media for a later agent turn can expose sensitive group content if the policy is not explicit.

options.title: Approve bounded retention
options.body: Allow a fix that records only authorized, local image history media under existing group/context visibility limits, bounded media count and TTL, with regression and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Reject unmentioned media retention
options.body: Keep the current no-download behavior for unmentioned group media and update docs so group context is explicitly text-only for this case.

options.title: Require an explicit opt-in
options.body: Add a narrowly documented opt-in only if maintainers decide existing group history/contextVisibility policy is not enough for this privacy boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded retention
recommendation.body: Allow a fix that records only authorized, local image history media under existing group/context visibility limits, bounded media count and TTL, with regression and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current blamed Telegram/channel history surfaces and recent channel-area landing point to this owner as the best routing candidate for the policy decision.
